from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/local')
control = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/invoice-regression-workflow-control.json')
output = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/free-local-coverage.json')
files = []
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').lower()
    files.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'invoice_tag_signals': {marker: marker in text for marker in ('sum(distinct', 'invoice_id', 'coalesce(sum', 'equal_invoice_amounts')}})
result = {'scope': 'Repository local-download directory. Confirm against the served release before making listing claims.', 'files': files, 'control_available': control.is_file(), 'coverage': 'available' if files and control.is_file() else 'incomplete'}
if control.is_file():
    data = control.read_bytes()
    cases = json.loads(data)['results']
    result['executed_control_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    result['queries_passing_every_recorded_case'] = sorted(set.intersection(*(set(case['passing_queries']) for case in cases))) if cases else []
    result['recorded_case_names'] = [case['case'] for case in cases]
result['interpretation'] = 'Marker matches are navigation evidence. Inspect matching material and verify the exact live inventory before deciding whether the candidate adds a distinct runnable exercise.'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
